author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Rewrote ripgrep core to use the new crate collection. Deleted old grep crate. CLI became thin translation layer from arguments to library options.

Sources:
- bb110c1: 'This commit does the work to delete the old grep crate and effectively rewrite most of ripgrep core to use the new libripgrep crates... The most complex part of ripgrep core is now arguably the translation between command line parameters and the library options, which is ultimately where we want to be.'
title: Migrated ripgrep CLI to use libripgrep
